items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Before we go any further, there’s one teacher that we haven’t talked about, of yours, and that’s Joe Allard.

ctx.x: Before we go any further, there’s one teacher that we haven’t talked about, of yours, and that’s Joe Allard.

Oh yeah, well, he was the guru of saxophone. Joe was from – we’ll backtrack. I’m about – I don’t know. Am I 16 or 17? After three or four years with Mr. Shapiro from Bromley studios, I can see that I got to move up. I literally take the phone book, saxophone teachers. I think it was even the yellow pages, and I called, among others – because you know some of these names – Marty Napoleon, Garvin Bushell. This is amazing, because he’s on that record Live at the Vanguard, playing bassoon, oh my God.
Right, but he went back to the ’20s.
